families.card_summary: A ten-plate comic field map of 52 distortions that bend evidence, from selective case-building to false finals.
families.summary: A pure comic expression of evidence discipline. The sequence follows the ways a record can be narrowed, echoed, inflated, pressured, and closed before it has been tested well enough to hold.
families.what_it_maps: Selective case-building, asymmetric selection, echoed authority, crowd and institution pressure, story and cause traps, numerical overreach, context and language fog, attachment, escalation, and premature closure.
families.why_it_matters: Public reasoning becomes more trustworthy when claims remain inspectable, contextual, revisable, and proportionate to the evidence. Comic form makes those distortions visible without requiring the reader to adopt a specialist vocabulary first.
families.meta_description: Evidence That Holds: a ten-plate Open Comic Series mapping 52 distortions that bend evidence and public reasoning.
